results.content:
As semiconductor process technologies continue to advance, more manufacturing space is required to produce the same output. Furthermore, HBM requires more wafers than conventional DRAM to produce the same memory capacity, resulting in significantly higher production resource requirements. Securing sufficient production capacity in advance has therefore become one of the most critical competitive advantages. [...] This decision was first and foremost driven by the company’s business needs and assessment of its global competitiveness. At the same time, developing a large-scale semiconductor cluster in Korea requires not only extensive land but also national-level infrastructure, including reliable electricity and water supply. Accordingly, SK hynix formulated this investment strategy after comprehensively considering the government’s semiconductor industry development policies, the overall business [...] The semiconductor industry delivers meaningful results only when corporate investment and industrial infrastructure are aligned. When manufacturing facilities and supporting infrastructure develop in tandem, they create a virtuous cycle that strengthens investment, employment, and industrial competitiveness. Based on this foundation, SK hynix will continue making stable and sustainable investments.

results.content:
Key-value cache is one of the most important memory challenges in large-language-model inference. During autoregressive generation, transformer models store key and value tensors from previous tokens. This avoids recomputing attention over the entire context. As context windows become longer, KV cache memory requirements grow significantly. [...] This tiered approach can make enterprise AI more practical. It reduces the need to keep everything in expensive memory and reduces the latency penalty of retrieving everything from slower storage.

## 10. KV Cache, Long Context, and Memory Expansion [...] The challenge is latency management. If the system moves data out of HBM and then needs it immediately, performance may suffer. Therefore, KV cache tiering requires prediction, scheduling, and prefetching. A standardized HBF layer can help by giving software developers a clear target for optimization.
